notes: 31.1" 4096x2160 (17:9) reference/master monitor, desktop unit (no rack ears in base config) — rackUnits omitted. SDI grouping per Sony's operating manual (cross-checked via manualslib.com): SDI1 IN1–4 and MONITOR OUT1–4 are 3G/HD-capable only; SDI2 IN1–2/OUT1–2 support up to 12G/6G/3G/HD (single-link 12G or dual/quad-link), while SDI2 IN3–4/OUT3–4 are 3G/HD only — SDI2 OUT mirrors the signal on the corresponding SDI2 IN. HDMI IN is listed by Sony only as "HDMI (HDCP2.3/1.4)" — that figure is the supported HDCP versions, not the HDMI signal version, so no bandwidth grade could be confirmed and it was omitted (medium confidence on this port only). AC IN connector type could not be confirmed as a specific IEC variant in available spec tables; "iec" (C13/C14-class) is inferred from Sony's manual noting a detachable "AC power cord and AC plug holder" are supplied — treat as medium confidence. Rear panel also has a "PARALLEL REMOTE" connector explicitly documented by Sony as reserved "for future expansion... currently unavailable" and a proprietary "SERVICE" port for factory use only — both omitted as non-functional/non-standard I/O. Power: AC 100–240V, 5.1–2.1A, 50/60Hz, ~450W max.
